name: 89503 · Reno, NV
findings: ZIP 89503 (Reno) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89503 (Reno) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89503 (Reno) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
